answer: In this PoA design, each service interaction updates an EigenTrust transition matrix, while reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life, so an agent must provide sustained honest service to retain eigenvector centrality. A freshly spawned Sybil identity starts with near-zero centrality; without reciprocal, time-persistent endorsements from established nodes, its score cannot cross the consensus threshold. Even aliases named quill, zenith, or cedar remain isolated and cannot pass consensus.
